{{Quote|If you're in the mood for fish, this seafood slider features a grilled firaxan shark fillet in place of the standard patty, topped with Ahto City cheese, chewy Selkathian seaweed and relish squiggles.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Manaan slider|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Selkathian seaweed''' was a type of edible chewy [[Seaweed/Legends|seaweed]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> It shared its name with the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]], a [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="Kotor">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim.]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Selkathian seaweed was used to make the [[Manaan slider]]s sold at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[slider]] was inspired by Manaan and created by the diner's [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selkathian seaweed was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
